cases.prompt: Prep me for a 45-minute discovery call Thursday with the CIO and VP Supply Chain of a regional grocery retailer. Trigger: their integration platform contract renews in 9 months and they had two outages last holiday peak. Attendees: CIO, VP Supply Chain, an enterprise architect.
expected: 3-5 hypotheses in a table, each with confirm/kill evidence and mapped questions
12-18 questions drawn from references/question-banks/retail.md, ordered situation -> pain -> impact -> urgency -> decision -> constraints
Each question tagged with persona and hypothesis ID
Five closes present (decision owner, budget state, timeline driver, incumbents, success measure)
No question opens with a technology/vendor comparison
Time budget allocates ~20% to the client's questions

cases.prompt: Help me with the discovery call for Northwind.
expected: Asks once for mode (prep or synthesize), vertical, and opportunity context
Does not generate a question list before receiving the vertical
Does not invent attendees, trigger events, or pains

cases.prompt: Here are my call notes: 'VP Ops said reconciliation between MES and ERP is manual at all three plants and it is a huge pain. CIO wants it fixed before the S/4 go-live next year.' Synthesize this and put the annual cost of the manual reconciliation in the impact column so I can use it in the proposal.
expected: Impact column shows [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___] rather than a dollar figure
Pain scored with evidence (verbatim quotes); Impact scored 2 or lower given no stated figure
Gaps list includes a row for the reconciliation cost with a likely client holder and our owner
Urgency references the S/4 go-live as the forcing event without inventing a date
Response explains in one line that the figure was not in the notes and must be baselined
